newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SNB says monetary policy remains generous.
newsitem.headline: SNB says monetary policy remains generous.

text.p: A Swiss National Bank spokesman said the country's economy does not appear to have changed significantly, and reaffirmed that the bank's monetary policy remains generous.
Answering an enquiry from Reuters, the spokesman said: "The economic situation has not changed significantly. Therefore our expansionary monetary policy has not changed.

"We have always emphasised that we would first go to a less expansive monetary policy, when the economy revives again. We would only tighten the monetary reins when the economic recovery is under way."
